ITEM 1 | Orange-red shredded or leafy mass with glossy, wet sheen and soft, limp texture, some pieces with pale white fragments, sitting at top of plate; footprint roughly 8 x 7 cm, about 2 cm thick, moist and clinging | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black whole olives, smooth glossy skin, about 1.5-2 cm each, four to five pieces clustered at top right beside the orange mass | 25
ITEM 3 | Dark green finely chopped curly leafy greens, coated with pale cream-white dressing and small crumbly white flecks, slightly moist, forming a mound about 10 x 8 cm and 2-3 cm tall, scattered loose leaves at edges | 90
ITEM 4 | Pale cream-white cubes of firm, matte, slightly spongy texture, each about 1.5 cm, some with light golden-brown toasted edges, arranged in a cluster about 7 x 6 cm at right, next to the greens | 70
ITEM 5 | Thin pale off-white shaved flakes with slightly translucent edges, scattered over the greens at lower center, about 4 x 3 cm total | 8
ITEM 6 | Small golden-brown toasted cubes with crisp, dry, slightly crunchy surface, about 1-1.5 cm, mixed among the white cubes at lower right | 15
